nom: Party of You Cult Cream Cold Cream Cleanser + Hydrating Mask

segments.sensitive: Reports from reviewers with sensitive skin are mixed: several say it's gentle, fragrance-free and doesn't irritate or cause breakouts, but multiple others describe burning, itching, tingling or redness and recommend patch-testing first.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report strong hydration, describing it as a go-to hydrating mask or cleanser that restores moisture without a tight or stripped feeling.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin describe the rich, thick texture as potentially too heavy for daily use, suggesting it works better as an occasional winter moisturizer than a regular cleanser.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin reports it effectively hydrates dry areas around the mouth without irritating the rest of the face.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across dry, sensitive and combination skin, report strong hydration and softness after use, with several specifically praising it for restoring moisture during winter or after drying acne treatments.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation, but a minority describe burning on application, itching, or a tingly, reddened feeling after use, particularly with sensitive skin, and recommend a patch test first.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers who describe their skin as oily or acne-prone find the rich, thick texture can feel heavy and suggest using it occasionally rather than as a daily cleanser or moisturizer.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report no new breakouts from the cream despite concerns about its shea butter content, and several with acne-prone skin note it did not cause whiteheads or flare-ups.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the cream with gently cleansing without stripping the skin barrier.

aspects.libelle: Struggles to fully remove waterproof mascara and eye makeup
Handy built-in spatula for scooping product
Doesn't lather or foam like a typical cleanser
Can require a wipe or second cleanse to fully rinse off
Generous size gives good value for money

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's very thick and it did an OK job. I'll take it off my makeup. I would only use this cream as a moisturizer in the winter if you're an oily person, but I would not recommend using on a daily basis.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The Cult Cream Cold Cream Cleanser has a very soft, creamy texture that feels gentle on the skin. It's easy to apply and remove, and it cleans my makeup extremely well without requiring a lot of rubbing. My skin feels clean and smooth right after cleansing. However, I did experience a slight itching sensation on my skin afterward, which may be due to sensitivity. While the products perform well in terms of cleansing and hydration, those with sensitive skin may want to patch test before regular use. Overall, these products are effective and luxurious in texture, but may not be ideal for very sensitive skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have dry skin so this product helps with hydrating. It doesn't have a scent, it can be used as a mask putting it on the skin for 15 minutes. It has jojoba oil & shea butter. It leaves your skin soft and hydrating
